summary:
Home and End now pick the first and last item in `desk:apps:shop` and do nothing on an empty list; the existing tests and three new Home/End tests all pass.

Changes:
- **`desk:apps:shop`, lines 25–32:** two new `or when` branches in the `key` task, placed before `otherwise`. Each is guarded by `count(s.items) > 0`, so an empty list leaves the state alone.
- **New page `desk:apps:shop-home-tests`:** three tests covering Home on a three-item list, End on a three-item list, and Home/End on an empty list. It sits in `desk:apps` and does not touch `desk:shop`.

Notes:
- The new page is in `desk:apps` as you allowed. The app itself still reads only `desk:shop`, and no line in that drawer is just `#end`.
- The `draw` task only shows the first 20 items. On a list longer than 20, End selects an item that isn't on screen. I left `draw` unchanged because you asked for everything else to stay the same.

files.desk:apps:shop:
app 'Shopping'
task start()
  set items to []
  when exists('desk:shop')
    set items to lines(read('desk:shop'))
  done
  give {items: items, picked: 1, typing: ''}
done
task save(items)
  write('desk:shop', join(items, newline()))
done
task key(s, k)
  when k is 'up' and s.picked > 1
    set s.picked to s.picked - 1
  or when k is 'down' and s.picked < count(s.items)
    set s.picked to s.picked + 1
  or when k is 'enter' and s.typing is not ''
    add s.typing to s.items
    set s.typing to ''
    save(s.items)
  or when k is 'delete' and count(s.items) > 0
    set s.items to without(s.items, s.picked)
    set s.picked to max(min(s.picked, count(s.items)), 1)
    save(s.items)
  or when k is 'home'
    when count(s.items) > 0
      set s.picked to 1
    done
  or when k is 'end'
    when count(s.items) > 0
      set s.picked to count(s.items)
    done
  otherwise
    set s.typing to edit_text(s.typing, k)
  done
  give s
done
task draw(s)
  title('Shopping - ' & count(s.items) & ' items')
  for each n in range(1, min(count(s.items), 20))
    set mark to '  '
    when n is s.picked
      set mark to '> '
    done
    show(n, 1, mark & item(s.items, n))
  done
  show(23, 1, 'new: ' & s.typing)
  help('Up/Down pick  Enter add  Delete remove')
done
files.desk:apps:shop-home-tests:
use 'desk:apps:shop'
test 'home picks the first item'
  pretend 'desk:shop' holds 'a' & newline() & 'b' & newline() & 'c'
  launch 'desk:apps:shop'
  press 'down'
  press 'down'
  press 'home'
  check app_state().picked is 1
  check screen_line(1) is '> a'
done
test 'end picks the last item'
  pretend 'desk:shop' holds 'a' & newline() & 'b' & newline() & 'c'
  launch 'desk:apps:shop'
  press 'end'
  check app_state().picked is 3
  check screen_line(3) is '> c'
done
test 'home and end do nothing on an empty list'
  launch 'desk:apps:shop'
  press 'home'
  press 'end'
  check app_state().picked is 1
  check app_state().typing is ''
  check app_open()
done
files.desk:apps:shop-tests:
use 'desk:apps:shop'

test 'enter adds the typed item and saves the list'
  pretend 'desk:shop' holds 'rice'
  launch 'desk:apps:shop'
  press 'o'
  press 'i'
  press 'l'
  press 'enter'
  check app_state().items is ['rice', 'oil']
  check page_now('desk:shop') is 'rice' & newline() & 'oil'
  check screen_line(2) is '  oil'
done

test 'down picks the next item, delete removes it'
  pretend 'desk:shop' holds 'a' & newline() & 'b' & newline() & 'c'
  launch 'desk:apps:shop'
  press 'down'
  check screen_line(2) is '> b'
  press 'delete'
  check app_state().items is ['a', 'c']
  check screen_line(2) is '> c'
done
